label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Gostol et Gannath Domm
english: IV.1 · Of the Felling of the Black Pillars

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et heth pawast, ul Hyll Pawast.
english: *The second spring, in the Second Tide.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadh Seren Pa Luth, hy scaevureleth et Stonwrytan um et Derryl. Re veske Halyna so lom ul vesseth, eth re rytym hyonta, pynt sost; re ferrent en dolmath hosen linth ul helvhoss.
english: *Laid by Seren Two-Inks, out of the Harvest rolls of the guild. {{Halyna}} read them me by night, and I copied after them so fast that my letters leaned like reeds in a wind.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Keth et tolm, Seren.
english: Hold the stone, Seren.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vesker hos surr, amm ul vess sa re lilv et crest re rarrar dem vimmow vestul rytow. Re yal bunth et scaevurel hemm sost lilvet, eth re hresk o lo nindeth Hyna. Nath re veske Halyna hos trenn ulo lom tul; hosast re rytym sy:
english: A year had we read, when on a night of thaw we came to the bottom of the archive chest. The cord on the oldest roll was rotten, and broke in Rhyna's fingers. No line of it would {{Halyna}} read me till I had written this:

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re hossan o,
english: "We two lived it not,"

label: Romanisation
rom: veth re hossant gedheth ol nedheth o. Re rytent o, eth nath re veskent fedh galat sa re rytent.
english: "but our fathers' fathers lived it. They wrote it down, and never read what they had written."

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul scaevurel hemm sost doss et myst rytet hosen esket dommel ul gless et wadh, eth nayalat ullen. Hy ull el pessyl o, sa re vessent ul vessvarath, eth sa re dhess nahos fedh: vodh ew o, eth cedh re hoss o. Amm re rarr et tessyl, nath re yal o rytet ul ol narl.
english: In the oldest roll the grey is but a blackish veil on the rim of the sea. After that it is a question, asked in the night-watches and never answered: what it was, and who breathed it. The answer, when it came, was not written in our hand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re rarr molt syst, amm re yal lyrness um et cummath. Re orrant et scetheth dem neld, ul vodh nath re werdent so yedheth, eth ul gless et myst re weskent et gannath domm ul so dhrenneth, venn hosen venndhrenn. Re vollant et higileth so: Gannath Myst, hy vodh re hethent et myst dem susk, hosen re veskent, hosen kethent gannath crisur. Re yal et mesk domm duss hy russvesk, eth lelv hy russtyvil, eth re vemess o lilvyl.
english: Then came the high summer of the havens' pride. Farther than their fathers had dared went the ships, and at the hem of the grey they found the black pillars in their ranks, straight as a plumb-line. The ship-masters named them the Mystholders, for they seemed to hold the grey up as posts hold a roof. Harder than oak was their timber, and lighter than iron, and proof against rot.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo dhrenn pa dhesk re lusk Redul Serdul et dannwresketh dem neld. Kethent et scaevureleth et nydhyl, havul eth havul. Hunna o amm sy, eth ketha o, hy vodh doss o lor.
english: Two generations the Trade Council sent out the axes. The rolls keep the count, cargo by cargo. Hear it now, and hold it, for it is ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Mesk domm, dem homarath eth heskalath. Mesk domm, dem sull heskal ul Gemm Hyll, eth dem nannath Sedhnell. Mesk domm, dem grisurvesketh Lurrvard, eth dem memmerdeth Dhaldow Helv. Mesk domm, dem salereth Rullsorth, eth dem hellur um et crest lo Frennvar. Mesk domm, vorrat niss ul drunnowath Dhavow Vorr. Eth ul Gethow Stellath re yalant et dannwresketh drunnat, eth re vymment dem gless dem stinyl mest.
english: Black wood, for buttresses and bridges. Black wood, for the three spans at Tidesmeet, and the pilings of Fenholm. Black wood, for the roof-trees of Holtward, and the cranes of Highreach. Black wood, for the galleries of Sandreach, and the hall on the ice at Rimewatch. Black wood, burned slow in the forges of Emberhythe. And at Carnhold the axes were beaten out, and went back to the edge for more.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull, et galatath sa nath re vaverent galat hosen ull.
english: Then the things that needed naught of the kind.

label: Romanisation
rom: Mesk domm, dem bressir vilvhellur vithul Dhavow Hemm.
english: Black wood, to floor the dancing-hall of a lord of Eldhythe.

label: Romanisation
rom: Mesk domm, dem serdulyentheth et tavowlesteth, eth so nulesshrynireth.
english: Black wood, for the trade-tables of the harbour-houses, and their dice-boards.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: [Lo sy doss et scaevurel luthat, eth doss sull trenn mammat.]
english: *[Here the roll is stained, and three lines are lost.]*

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo rask sost, re rann vaskorn ul Gemm Hyll hos gann ul hos lodull.
english: Last of all, a merchant of Tidesmeet had one pillar hewn into a single bed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re aedh o ulo, eth re yal lyrness umo.
english: He slept in it, and was proud.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hyl Halvard et flenn, eth re vymm o dem o.
english: Halvard turned the leaf, and turned it back.

label: Romanisation
rom: Kethent et scaevureleth nydhyl ullen lo sest ull, dyss hyo. Ul vodh re yal gann gostat, re dhald gendan hy et brynt, venn eth domm. Re vymment et gostardath dem stinyl o, hy vodh re rarrant gannath gell hyo; eth re lenull et Stonwrytan so dem brynur.
english: Beside that count the rolls keep a stranger one. Where a pillar was felled, the stump put up new growth, straight and black. Back went the axemen to cut it, for it made good poles, and the guild bought them for scaffold.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re stinent o, eth re dhev o. Re stinent o, eth re dhev o. Re stinent o.
english: They cut it, and it grew. They cut it, and it grew. They cut it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vimm nydhyl gannath re hess nind Hyna. Re ryt saevul hos trenn mest, lyss sost: pa fedh re ferrym et greller dem o, eth hy ull re vesk ey o.
english: Below a count of poles Rhyna's finger stopped. A clerk had written one line more, so small that twice I bent the lamp to it ere she could read it.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Lo dhrenn et cless tunn, re dhald nayalat hy et brynteth.
english: *All along the edge, the stumps put up nothing.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re ryt nahos hy vodh, eth re vess nahos. Nath re vysk et scaevurel cedh ew et garl. Amm re vysk o, es gethym voll et garl.
english: No man wrote why, and no man asked. Whose hand it was, the roll saith not. I would have kept his name.

label: Romanisation
rom: Fedh eth fedh re wynt et myst, eth re voll et Redul o: Pussal. Re raevulom et brod ull ul vimm en serr, eth nath re heth o, hosen grull hy lodh hemm.
english: Season by season the grey thinned, and the Council named it fortune. I tried that word under my tongue, and it gave, like mortar gone to sand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re veltir et Stonwrytan et Redul. Doss o ul ol narl sost, um flenn sa nath re yal domm hy nindeth fedh:
english: The Stonewrights warned the Council. It is in our own hand, on a leaf that no thumb had darkened:

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Tevent et mesketh sy ul drun dyss. Lymment et ryteteth sa wesker lo so sest brodhen sa nath noss veskyl lor. Ul vodh naross poduloth, hessyth ol lestir.
english: *"These trees grow in strange soil. The carvings we find beside them bear a tongue we cannot read. Where wisdom is absent, let restraint be our guide."*

label: Romanisation
rom: Veth tevar re resk serdul ul reskow strom, eth re yal ol niltenn hosen galat sa vyskent scaelurath lo et vorr. Hos fedh re yal et peltir vesket ul garm, ul redulhellur Dhavow Hemm. Hy ull re hadhant o um yenth.
english: But trade sat in the high seat by then, and our counsel was a thing grandmothers said by the fire. Once was the warning read aloud, in the Council hall at Eldhythe. Then was it laid on a shelf.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy vodh re yal ryteteth. Lo visketh et gannath re weskent et gostardath tolmath cadhat venn, rytet ul rellorath kylet, rerr hosen frenn um risker. Re yal veskyl lo nahos.
english: For there were carvings. At the feet of the pillars the axemen found stones set upright, cut with curling letters, as beautiful as frost on a window. No man could read them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re haemerent merr ul davowlesteth, kylet dem rerrel. Re fimment uldath ul vimm et tolmath, eth re nydhent. Re roskur et Stonwrytan et ullen ul rytowath, eth et peltir sost lont.
english: Some hung in the harbour-houses, reduced to ornament. Men drank under them, and did their reckoning. The rest the guild locked in its archives, and its own warning with them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Solant merr hyont lo yerd, ul et vestul sa re lymmym dem susk et brunn. Re hadha Halyna gemm garl umont, eth re hebbent nayalat lonta. Nath noss brodlymmyl lo dholm.
english: Some of those lie in the chest at my knee, that I carried up the mountain. {{Halyna}} have laid their four hands on them, and been given naught. Stone does not translate.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul molt nydhyleth hos syst desir re wesk Halvard flenn hy et deldvar hyvenn sost. Re ryt saevul o ul lodh nydhyl gannath eth nydhyl nestullath, ul hos vothol. Re vesk Halvard o hosen re vesk o et nestullath.
english: Among the counts of one late summer Halvard came on a letter from the outermost post. A clerk had copied it between a count of poles and a count of oars, with the same care. Halvard read it as he had read the oars.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Besk nasesket. Dask bynden. Hesset. Sceth vorrat eth luskat.
english: *Unknown intruder. Hostile intent. Neutralized. Vessel burned and released.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo o visk doss voll stinet: ▒▒▒▒. Re hadh Rhyna ey nind um et luth, eth re rik ey o hyo.
english: At its foot a name is cut out: ▒▒▒▒. Rhyna laid her finger on the blot, and took it away.

label: Romanisation
rom: Um et flenn fennet doss pa sulter et mesk domm stinet hy nydhyl havul, eth lo so sest, ul hos garl: mammat ul gless.
english: On the next leaf two timber-boats are struck off a cargo-list, and beside them, in the same hand: *lost at the edge.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rytym o hosen re ryt et saevul o, ul lodh et gannath eth et nestullath.
english: I copied it as the clerk had, between the poles and the oars.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re seskym vodh re hethym.
english: What I held, I wist not.

label: Romanisation
rom: New poduloth sa re hess et Derryl, veth kylyth uldath: re yalant et gannath virr merr, eth re hebbent brunneleth et bridlern mesk mest naryll. Hy surr et sulter sa vorr, nath re vaver hos garlan lussol ul veskyl et myst, eth nath re vyskent et scaevureleth hy vodh. Hy ull re hessent et dannwresketh. Re naelur nahos o.
english: Not wisdom ended the Harvest, but the fickleness of men: the near pillars grew scarce, and the northern hills sent cheaper timber. After the year of the burning boat no crew would row within sight of the grey, and the rolls say not why. So the axes stopped. No one decided it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re nadhumant et cummath. Ul susk et braemur eth et nuless re haemerent et tolmath tul, eth re vessent tevath vodh myskent so, eth re yal mysket lont nayalat. Ew et tevath ull merr hyos, sa reskys lo et vorr sy.
english: Then the havens forgat. Over the ale and the dice the stones hung on, and children asked what they said, and were told naught. Some of you that sit at this fire were those children.

label: Romanisation
rom: Desir, desir sost, re hyl scaevur lyrness. Re yalant lesteth Vardh clennet, eth re yystent uldath ol lusulath crystil pawast, dem bessyl niltenn, sumess hosen uldath sa hlennent hald wadh ul vonul. Re vess nahos um et tolmath, eth re vysker nayalat. Ew ol sa re hyler et roskur. El ol saed ull.
english: Late, very late, the wheel of pride turned. The temples were mended, and men climbed our worn steps again for counsel, glad as men that mend a sea-wall in the calm. Of the stones none asked, and we said naught. It was we who turned the key. That is our share of it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Veth re rarr nestornoth desir.
english: But humility came too late.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yalant et wemmeth domm hosast tevar um et wadh.
english: The first dark sails were already on the sea.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: Gebb et Pard
english: IV.3 · The Warden's Door

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Et grem sullast, ul Hyll Dhumol.
english: *The third winter, in the Tide of Remembering.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Brodath Wrenn Reldvar, hosen re rike Wendhessa so hy o wrodow ul hemmyth, ganna et Stonwrytan ul Davow Hemm. Re veske Halyna so lo et odh sy, eth re hadhom ryt surr ul so sestow.
english: *The words of Brenn of the outpost, as {{Wendhessa}} of the guild at Eldhythe took them from his mouth in his old age. {{Halyna}} read them at this hearth, and the annal after them is mine.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s caption
rom: Rellor Wendhessa, pa rytowvard Dhavow Hemm, um hosk havul Wrenn, hosen re hresk o
english:
::: native legend_seal_wendhessa chip
The mark of {{Wendhessa}}, the archivists of Eldhythe, on the seal of Brenn's bundle, as it was broken
:::

label: Romanisation
rom: Kethen et tolm,
english: "We two hold the stone,"

label: Romanisation
rom: veth nath noss et brodath lona. Hosen re yalant rytet, hosen sy vesken so.
english: "but the words are not ours. As they were written, so we read them."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal rostnoth surr lom. Re yalar delv, eth et pard, ul neldvar dasken et gaed, ul vodh hask et hal dem et myst. Re yal Tobe hemm piskurard lo et cless noth eth murr surr. Ew et haskard en; re rytym amm re yal lesknoth surr lom, en narl ryss um dholm et haskardath: Galat sa re veskym, lymmym o. Nath lymmym galat ullen. Ston.
english: Nineteen I was. Twelve were we, and the warden, at the last post of the land, where the rock runneth out toward the grey. Old Tobe had fished the edge thirty years. I was the runner, sworn at fifteen with mine hand flat on the runners' stone: "What I saw, I carry. I carry nothing else."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh ▒▒▒▒ et mesk domm ul et deldvar tunn: ul nannath et gebb, ul o yenth, ul stomorn et lodull. Re heth o et deldvar lo voll o yedh ul Redul Serdul, eth new mest hemm hy et haskard o. Hy vodh ew bith o volt, re luskant o dem gless, ul vodh nath re omm o veth umor, et delv. Re sesk o stemir nafedh. Re sesk o hydull nafedh.
english: Black wood had ▒▒▒▒ set everywhere: in the doorposts, in his table, in the frame of his bed. He held the post by his father's name on the Trade Council, and was scarce older than his runner. For his temper they had sent him to the edge, where there were but the twelve of us for it to wound. He had never known battle. He had never known patience.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hos ryst lo rask syst, re vellor sulter lyss myst hy et myst. Nath re yal helvhoss, veth re vellor et sulter.
english: One morning at summer's end, out of the grey came a small grey boat. There was no wind, and the boat came anyway.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re dhav et besk o, eth re orr o dem susk dem nebb et pard. Re ston ▒▒▒▒ ul et lest, eth nath re rarr o mest virr dem et gebb. Ew susk et besk, eth stacorn, eth covvat ul mystroval sa re varr amm nath re varr o. Nath re veskym hesp umo.
english: The stranger beached it, and walked up to the warden's door. ▒▒▒▒ stood within, and came no further. Tall was the stranger, and pale, and clad in a mist-cloth that moved when he moved not. No weapon saw I on him.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wrodh o hosast ul o wrodhen sost, bont, hosen helvhoss nerdess ul lurr hemm; eth re yal ludal umor. Nath re sesker: hosen sy brodhant so, eth nayalat ullen. Hy ull re vysk o sull brod orrowen, vothen, hosen cadh uld galat sa hresk nayess.
english: First he spake in his own tongue, loud, like a storm-wind in old trees, and we were afraid. We wist not that it is but how they speak. Then said he three words of ours, carefully, as a man setteth down a thing that might break.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hess… Helv… Sennyl…
english: "Stop… Sky… Dying…"

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew brodath venn so, brodhat venn. Seskym o amm sy. Veth el hunnatath hosel brodath sa nath noss trenn lont, eth nath re hunnar veth hunnatath.
english: They were the right words, and truly spoken. I know it now. Yet words without sentences are but sounds, and we heard but sounds.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re lumm o um vysul, eth re hadh o ul lern et pard tolm domm, strom hosen pa yarl. Re hadh o o hosen es gadhos blenth ul lern arra. Nath re varr hos hyor. Ul o sestow re rarr wadhnas dem vimm, eth re orr o ul molt et tolmath.
english: Then kneeled he on the step, and set before the warden a dark stone, the size of two fists. He set it down as ye would set down bread before a guest. No man of us moved. Behind him a gull came down, and walked among the stones.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re visk ▒▒▒▒ o lo sest.
english: ▒▒▒▒ kicked it aside.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re orr o ul et tuss lo et hald. Hy ull re dhyvullant uldath et pard. Re stonom lo so sest, eth hunnom et dhyvullol ull tul.
english: Into the dust by the wall it went. Then laughed his men. I stood among them, and I hear that laughter yet.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re dhald et besk. Re hadh o o yarl venn um sestow wiskyann et pard, dagorn, hosen re yald odha lom amm re yal suress umom. Re wamm o so wisketh olen dem femmyl et bisklerneth, eth re yal o ul velvyth. Re ston ▒▒▒▒, eth re lusk o o ul femmyl. Kaeverym: amm re hess o lo ull, es morr ol hossol ullen.
english: The stranger rose. His right hand he laid on the back of the warden's neck, gently, as my mother did when I had a fever. He drew their heads together till the foreheads touched, and was silent. ▒▒▒▒ stood and let it be done. Had it stopped there, I think all our lives had gone otherwise.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re rik et besk preller lyss ul o yarl ullen, eth re femm o o um sestyarl venn et pard.
english: Then took the stranger a little blade in his left hand, and touched it to the warden's right arm.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re dhresk ▒▒▒▒ hyo. Nath re rarr lorr hyo fedh ul o hossol. Ul dreskyl, re orr gunn et ryt sa re yal kaeveret venthen, eth re rarr et lorr.
english: ▒▒▒▒ tore himself away. Never in his life had he bled. In the tearing, the cut that should have been shallow went deep, and the blood came.

label: Romanisation
rom: Grika o, re scyndal o.
english: "Seize him," he screamed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rikent o. Nath re yorr o. Re yal et preller tul ul o yarl, kylet dem o sestyarl sost. Ul lodh so yarlath pawast re lumm o, ul vodh re lumm o lo o hebbet. Nath re hyrrilym o.
english: They seized him. He fought them not. The blade was yet in his hand, turned to his own arm. Between their hands he went down on his knees again, where he had kneeled with his gift. I understood it not.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hurra o, re scyndal ▒▒▒▒.
english: "Kill him," screamed ▒▒▒▒.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re rikent galat sa re yal lo yarl: hultereth, eth tolmath et dhysal, eth gannath et sultereth. Re rik hos hyont en nann, et gann sa re hastom et sultereth lo.
english: They took up what lay to hand: staves, and stones of the shingle, and the boat-poles. One of them took up my pole, the pole I pushed the boats off with.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re wemm o o yarl. Amm re harm o, re yal o ul o wrodhen sost, eth re hunnom o hosen helvhoss. Re nydhym et drunnath. Nydhym so tul. Amm re sol o, re ser ▒▒▒▒ ul scyndalol, eth re serent merr. Re hreskent pa sestyarl et besk: et hos sa re heth biskyann et pard dagorn sost, eth et hos sa re heth et preller.
english: He lifted not his hand. If he cried out, it was in his own tongue, and I took it for the wind. The blows I counted. I count them yet. When he lay still, ▒▒▒▒ screamed on, and some went on. Both his arms they broke: the one that had held the warden's neck so gently, and the one that had held the blade.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lynirent uldath et pard.
english: His men obeyed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lynirer.
english: We obeyed.

label: Romanisation
rom: Myskym ol, hy vodh ew hos galat et deldvar orl ull, eth re yalom ulo. Nath re hadhom garl umo. Nath re hessym so. Ew luld en ul molt uldath.
english: I say *we*, for the post was one thing that day, and I was of it. No hand laid I on him. I did not stop them. A boy was I among the men.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re yal velvyth, eth re orr et wadhnas.
english: Then was it quiet, and the gull was gone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wammant o lo o visketh um et dhysal, dem et wadh, eth re femm o wisk gor dholm. Re rigent o ul o sulter sost, hosen drig piskurard piskur treskat ul vimmow sulter.
english: By the heels they drew him down the shingle, and his head went on every stone. Into his own boat they cast him, as a fisher casteth a torn net into the bilge.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth ▒▒▒▒ o sestyarl, eth nath re vesk o et sulter.
english: ▒▒▒▒ held his arm, and looked not at the boat.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vorra o, re vysk o, eth hasta o dem neld, eth hebba o dem hyll. Luska nayalat sa hebb veskyl.
english: "Burn it," said he, "and shove it off, and give it the tide. Leave naught to show."

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadhant o ul vorr, eth nath re vorr o hosen vorr mesk. Re yal scyndalol ulo. Re yal et besk sennet. New uld sa re scyndal. Ew et mesk sost.
english: They set it alight, and it burned not as wood burneth. There was a screaming in it. The stranger was dead. It was no man that screamed. It was the wood itself.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hastant o dem neld lo et gannath sost. Re orr Tobe hemm ul et wadh dem o yerdeth, eth re ridh o et gannath. Re stonar et ullen um et dhysal, eth nath re vaverer veskyl, eth re vesker.
english: With the same poles they shoved it off. Old Tobe went into the sea to his knees and washed the poles. The rest of us stood on the shingle, and would not look, and looked.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul neld, re hyl et sulter. Re orr o ul lern et helvhoss, eth ul lern et kess, eth ul et myst, ul vorr.
english: Well out, the boat turned. Into the wind it went, and against the current, and into the grey, burning.

label: Romanisation
rom: Orl ull sost re harm ▒▒▒▒ lo saevul, eth re ryt et saevul dem et Redul. Re yalom lo sest, eth doss o vyskyl lom hy volt:
english: That same day ▒▒▒▒ had the clerk write to the Council. I stood by, and I can say it by heart:

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Besk nasesket. Dask bynden. Hesset. Sceth vorrat eth luskat.
english: *Unknown intruder. Hostile intent. Neutralized. Vessel burned and released.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss brod um et hebbet. Nath noss brod um et lummol.
english: No word of the gift. No word of the kneeling.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul ryst fennet, amm re aedh gor hos tul, re rikym et tolm hy et tuss. Nath seskym hy vodh re yaldom o. Lo o yebb re hebb ▒▒▒▒ et flenn lom. Hosen sy re orrant et hebbet eth et nycul ul hos havul, eth re haskom o.
english: On the morrow, ere any woke, I picked the stone out of the dust. Why I did it, I know not. At his door ▒▒▒▒ gave me the letter. So the gift and the lie went into one pack, and I ran it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re haskom hos orl eth hos vess, eth bost lusul eth bost lusul re vyskym et ryt pawast.
english: A day and a night I ran, and every mile I said the oath over.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul Davow Hemm re vesk saevul hemm et Redul o, luth um o nindeth, eth re vesk o dem susk lom.
english: At Eldhythe an old clerk of the Council read it, with ink on his fingers, and looked up at me.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ho ross o hosen sy?
english: "Is it so?"

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re vyskym: Doss o hosen sy. Re vyskym: Doss o rytet. Pa vurr surr re nydhym et kylyl lyss ull.
english: I said not that it was so. I said, "It is written." Forty years have I weighed that small cleverness.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymmym et nycul ul hos orl eth hos vess. Re lymmym et vennoth pa vurr surr, eth re hebbym o lo nahos.
english: I carried the lie in a day and a night. I carried the truth forty years, and gave it to no one.

label: Romanisation
rom: Bremm ull re dhyvull et Orrow um sull gostard, sa re vymment dem varn um vivenn, eth sa re rytent um sulter sa vorr hy et myst. Nath re dhyvullom, hy vodh re veskym o ul gylyl. Veth re vyskym nayalat. Re yal o rytet lo et Redul.
english: That autumn the shore laughed at three axemen, home on a spar, that sware to a burning boat out of the grey. I laughed not, for I had seen it turn. Yet I said naught. The Council had it in writing.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hovv ▒▒▒▒ covveleth sell dem sennyl, lo dhrenn systeth bith ul Davow Hemm; eth seskym hy vodh. Grem sa re orr, re senn o ul lodull et mesk domm. Dossom hosel tul hy et delv.
english: ▒▒▒▒ wore long sleeves the rest of his life, through the hot summers of Eldhythe, and I know why. Last winter he died in his bed of black wood. I am the last of the twelve.

label: Romanisation
rom: Pa vurr surr re sol et tolm ul vimmow en havul, eth nath re hethym o hos fedh. Hebbym o amm sy lo et brodath sy, eth pessym haerilyl lo Vardh, hy vodh nath noss hos lom dem bessyl veth Mardh.
english: Forty years the stone hath lain at the bottom of my pack, and not once have I held it. I give it up now with these words, and I ask God to forgive me, for there is none left to ask but God.

label: Romanisation
rom: Dem sy, brodath Wrenn. Luth eth luth, re yala Halyna nawrodh.
english: So far the words of Brenn. At every blot {{Halyna}} were silent.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymm sestyarl et pard hos rellor: saed yalat, treskat ul molt. Re heth et Redul et flenn.
english: The warden's arm bare one mark: the half of something, cut off in the middle. The Council kept the letter.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re senn Brenn, hosen cadh uld havul. Re lamm et Stonwrytan o ul vimm o voll. Re stin o voll et pard dem neld.
english: Brenn died, as a man setteth down a load. The guild buried him under his name. The warden's name it cut away.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hoska Wendhessa o wrodath, eth re wrodha so lo nahos. Ul et Ommol re lymme sona et vestul hy et cumm, o yarl um hos garlow, eth ey garl um et ullen. Um et Orrol re ommant sona sestyarlath. Re vyskent et tolmardath: Nath noss galat dyll ulo; eth re hebbent o lo pa dhevel sost: lo Dharnel, eth lom. Lo o yarl luskat re wysk Tarnel o viskur. Re veskym et bysketeth.
english: {{Wendhessa}} sealed his words, and told no one. At the Fall they bare the chest out, his hand on one handle, hers on the other. On the Road their arms failed. The masons said it held naught of worth, and gave it to the youngest, Tarnel and me. Tarnel knotted his net with his free hand. I watched the knots.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vess et hiskenn re sola Wendhessa, eth nath re dhalda. Lo et vestul re aedhen Tarnel eth en, o yarl um hos garlow, eth en narl um et ullen. Ul ryst re yal frenn um vana.
english: On the night of the pass {{Wendhessa}} lay down, and rose not. By the chest Tarnel and I slept, a hand each on a handle. At morning frost lay on both.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re rynn Tarnel.
english: Tarnel did not wake.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo ull re hessym vess sy, en narlath um et tolm. Hy ull re hadha Halyna sona yarlath lo so sest.
english: There I stopped tonight, with mine hands on the stone. Then {{Halyna}} laid theirs beside them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymm ey o gor lusul,
english: "She carried it every step,"

label: Romanisation
rom: eth hy et hiskenneth re lymm ey o hosel.
english: "and after the passes she carried it alone."

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath noss haral hemm hy sy ul molt et luntath: uld sa lumm lo tho yebb, ul vimm tho hrisur. Ew lunt yebbeth ol.
english: There is no older law among any people than this: that whoso kneeleth at your door is under your roof. We were a people of doors.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhan o hosen re yal cadhat lona.
english: This we lay as it was laid for us.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Nath re vysk et odh sy o fedh um hurrol sa re yald ol lunt sost. Re hadh Ebba hemm et tolm hosast, eth re yal et ullen niss dem fennyl. Veth re fennent.
english: *Never before had this hearth said it over a killing by our own. Old Ebba began it, and the rest were slow to follow. But they followed.*

label: Romanisation · the Captain’s answer
rom: Eth re hadh et Crenn et biskhovv dem sestow.
english: *And the Captain put his hood back.*

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Ul ryst re rytent et haskardath et ryt pawast, eth re hadhant gemm brod umo: Nel hosen lymmyl Wrenn. Re ryt Wik, et tevel sost, o bont sost.
english: *In the morning the runners sware their oath again, and added four words: Not as Brenn carried. Wick, the youngest, sware it loudest.*
